snippet.title: Tropico 7 | Gameplay Teaser (US)
snippet.description:
Tropico 7 will release in 2026 on PC (Steam, Epic Games), Xbox PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation®5. Play it day one with Game Pass.
 
Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.
 
***
 
Kalypso Media also publishes critically acclaimed strategy games like the Tropico series, Railway Empire, Commandos, Port Royale, Dungeons, Sudden Strike, and others for PC, PlayStation®, Xbox®, and Nintendo Switch™. Recent releases include Port Royale 4, Tropico 6 - Nintendo Switch™ Edition, Commandos 2 - HD Remaster, Tortuga - A Pirate's Tale, Railway Empire 2, Dungeons 4 and The Inquisitor.
